nom: Peter Thomas Roth Ultimate Solution 5 Multitasking Eye Cream

avis.texte: This is the first time I've used an eye cream that actually works. This stuff is powerful!

Im 37, trying to improve my dark circles and sunken eyes, from kids and poor sleep. I use this product nightly and it doesnt seem to do anything. It has a greasy texture and doesnt absorb well. It says to apply m twice a day but there's no way I would be able to apply this in the morning with my make up. Also, if you rub your eye or cry or somehow get any of this in your eye, it burns. I wouldn't buy this again.

I' love this product, but did they reformulate it or was it shipped a bad product? I received a half empty bottle that was super oily, smelled rancid, and was completely a different color and consistency than what I have received previously.

avis.titre: Helped with my undereye contact dermatitis
avis.texte: I had a contact dermatitis flare up under my eyes, this cream (which i received as a sample) helped alleviate the dryness and redness of the rash. Will be purchasing it and adding it to my skin care routine!
The brand recognition is why I purchased this product but I have not seem any significant changes since starting to use it. It is not worth the price and I would not purchase this again
It has worked wonders around my eyes. I will definitely buy again!
Really excited to try this eye cream. The brand has really good products. It will last you a long time. A little bit goes a long way. But….it will sting!! I do not recommend it.

I was looking for a bit more of a budget friendly, higher end, option than my usual eye cream so I thought I'd give this one a try. I've been using it for a few months and, overall, it's a very mid eye cream. It moisturizes nicely without being too heavy and I still feel some moisture in the morning which is nice. It also didn't cause milia or irritate my sensitive skin. Other than that, it does absolutely nothing and you can get a hydrating eye cream for less than this. I'll finish it up, but won't be repurchasing.

They really irrirate my eyes. Thats the whole point of eye cream that it doesnt bother the eyes. But after applying,within 10 minutes my eyes starts to burn and water. If i make the mistake of rubbing them,they get blurry and i have to wash my eyes. So will be reaturning this for sure
I wanted to live this product but I could not get over the smell. Returned it after a few uses.

I love PTR products. The Water Drench hydrating moisturizer is my HG! I also love the under eye patches. This I've tried so many ways and times and I can't tell you if it works because it burns my eyes so bad they water nonstop and it's painful. I am lucky in terms of my skin because it is not sensitive. I'd honestly take it off the market

I have yet to use itnlong enough to find out if it works but it burns my eyes. I will rey it for some more time and then might return it. I have to be super careful not to get too close to my eyes,as it starts stinging. But if i dont put it close enough,whats the point of "eye" cream then??

Got an add on Facebook. Put in my information, placed my order. NEVER received my product. Really sad. I use the insta firm so I was excited for this. I order so many things online I expect that from other product lines. But this... Heartbroken

So far, this is the best performing eye cream I've tried. As a senior, I've used many different eye creams. As a senior woman, I've tried many different eye creams. The Peter Thomas Roth Ultimate Solution 5 is the best performing, so far. It does very well with under eye bags (lifting, firming) and smooths fine wrinkles. It has helped with dark circles but not to the extent I was hoping.
This product is burning my eyes. At first I thought it was a case of dry eyes but it is not at all. My eyes are burning so bad and I have to cold compress them. I am very scared.

I got it in the PTR trial set with the anti aging cleanser and the 5 in 1 moisturizer. I've used it probably just five times, and my undereye circles are GONE! I didn't think it was even possible to fix my dark circles, nothing ever helped. Reccomend!

I love peter thomas roth products everything ive tried from them works so well. I had gotten this eye cream i have noticed it does works although hasnt helped with my dark circles, but be careful it burns and burns if gotten in your eyes. It does have a gritty texture almost and butned my eyes so bad i just couldn't use this anymore there are other eye creams that dont burn and work well

I love peter thomas roth products everything ive tried from them works so well. I had gotten this eye cream i have noticed it does works although hasnt helped with my dark circles, but be careful it burns and burns if gotten in your eyes. It does have a gritty texture almost and butned my eyes so bad i just couldn't use this anymore there are other eye creams that dont burn and work well
I have always been a fan of Peter Thomas Roth, so I tried this eye cream. It outranks every other one I have tried, and I saw a change within a week!

I thought the cream was irritating my eyes until I noticed the sandy/gritty feeling was IN the cream itself. Ignore all the 5 star reviews for a free product, those of us who spent our own money on this wouldn't recommend it!!

Wanted to really like this one but it isn't for me. After applying this (not on eyelids) my eyes would water & burn most of the day making putting on makeup useless. I dont notice a strong fragrance to get this reaction. Unfortunately i am unable to return it as I waitied too long because I wanted to try it a couple times after the first reaction happened to make sure it was this product. Each time, same reaction. Even tried it just at night & woke with burning watering eyes. Beware if you have sensitive eyes. It is a thicker consistency than a moisturizer.
I have been using this for a couple of months and can see no difference

I cant explain the gritty texturr as I thought maybe it was the product combination of things before the eye cream, but its not. It is a fine grit that literally only my undereyes feel. It weird. When I think of eye creams, I think rich, smooth, hydrating and this is not it. I wished it was based on its claims but won't be repurchasing. I wish I hadn't tossed the box because I would've returned it.
Very disappointing product does absolutely nothing as far as dark circles and puffiness.

I have to agree with the other reviewers that mentioned the gritty texture. no idea what's causing it, but it makes me not want to put this around my eyes. when I do, bc I spent my own money on this and it's not cheap, it seems to work well. I won't repurchase though.

I've been using this eye cream twice a day for a little over a week, and I'm blown away by the results - they're unbelievable! I have never had such dramatic results from any skin care product in my life. I have used an eye cream that costs about four times what this one does for years. We went on vacation and somehow I left it behind, which I didn't realize was a stroke of luck! There was an Ulta nearby. I looked on the website before I went and I decided to try this, because the price was great and it had excellent reviews. I can't believe the difference its made in just over a week. My fine lines and wrinkles are diminished, my under eye area is firmer and less crepey, dark circles are diminished, and my eyes just look brighter overall. We came home from our trip, and people who see me nearly every day were asking me if i had something done with my eyes while we were away. They said I looked 10 years younger! I will never stop using this wonderful eye cream, and I'm going to Ulta today to pick up the corresponding face cream. If you're thinking about this eye cream, go for it! I don't think you'll be disappointed. I am beyond thrilled with the results!

Am in my mid 50's with genetic VERY dark circles, wrinkles + dryness, rest of skin is normal. This eye cream is excellent & primes the eyes perfectly under my concealer (which is tough to pull off). After 3 weeks, plumper undereye, softening of some deeper lines & a bit less purple. Really loving this eye cream.

Ive just purchased this product and have used its only 4 times and have noticed that it clumps up when i touch it through out the day at all. Feels nice when you first apply though. Hoping to get rid of darkness on my undereye but to early to tell.

It was definitelg stuffed with multiple ingredients that might have worked, but it doesn't absorb well enough for it to work. It clogged my pores, sat on my face, felt heavy, and I didn't notice any positive change. I did have a few zits, though!

avis.titre: This product is awesome and I've only had it a week!
avis.texte: I love this eye product! I've only had it a week and can tell a difference in no longer having dark circles and the ouffiness is g-o-n-e. Yeah, I can't believe it either. I won't be changing eye products unless PTR comes out with something better. Must try.

I have never felt so great on my skin until after using this multitasking eye cream. My eyes look much brighter and younger. My eyes are less puffy and the dark circles are less noticeable. I work night shift for 12 hours a day and it had taken a toll on my skin. I am really grateful to find this brand that suits my skincare needs. I'm in my mid-30's, and this is a lifesaver. Offered by Peter Thomas Roth

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth The Ultimate Solution 5 Multitasking Eye Cream is a game-changer. Its potent blend tackles five eye concerns, from wrinkles to puffiness, with precision. The lightweight formula absorbs swiftly, leaving the delicate eye area hydrated and rejuvenated. A must-have for anyone seeking comprehensive eye care.

This eye treatment works great on my sensitive skin. It very gentle and it stays well under makeup. After a couple of uses, I see results. My wrinkles and puffiness is not as visible. It moisturizes and softens my under eye area. Gifted by peterthomasroth.

I am super huge on eye cream lately in this current moment in my life. I've been using this ultimate solution eye cream for quite some time and I'd say that the puffiness under my eyes has improved greatly since using it. I love this stuff and I definitely apply twice daily which is one time in the AM with my morning skincare routine and again before bed after removing my makeup.would suggest to those who struggle with their dark circles or puffiness. Received complimentary from Peterthomasroth.

So far I am loving these Ultimate Solution 5 Multitasking Eye Cream gifted to me by Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare! It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated. I would definitely recommend to a friend

This eye cream was gifted by PTR! I really liked this eye cream! In just application, you feel the immediate effects of hydration! The product contains my favorite ingredients such as ceramides, caffeine, and even vitamin C! Just as the name implies, I LOVE how it has 5 uses: wrinkles, puffiness, loss of firmness, dark circles, and dryness! I haven't seen much difference in wrinkles since I am 23, but I can totally vouch for puffiness, dark circles, firmness, and dryness! love love love the eyecream! Great for every night!

I struggle with dark circles around the eyes, so I'm always on the lookout for products that can address these concerns. The formula of this eye cream is rich and luxurious, and it absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling greasy. What I love most about this eye cream is its multitasking nature. After using it for a few weeks, I noticed that my under-eye area looks smoother and brighter. Gifted by peterthomasroth

I received this eye cream gifted by Peter Thomas Roth. I can't say that I've seen much of a difference in my dark circles or fine lines, but I'll continue to use in hopes that I'll see some results with extended use. This eye cream definitely has a grit to it that does dissipate as you rub it in, but I prefer not to rub around my eyes, so this can take a while. It also irritated my eyes a bit if I got too close.

avis.titre: Doesn't crease under concealer! Brightened my undereyes!
avis.texte: This product feels almost mousse-like to me. It is so airy and lightweight. A little goes a long way. I have been loving using it daily. My undereyes feel refreshed and my skin absorbs it quickly. It helps so my concealer doesn't crease too much. It doesn't peel with makeup on top and it has brightened the overall appearance of my dark circles! This was gifted to me by Peter Thomas Roth but this is my honest opinion.

I received this item complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth and I think the eye cream is great. It's lightweight even tho it is definitely creamy it absorbs into the skin very well. It leaves my under-eye area moisturized and hydrated. A little definitely goes a long way.

I like how the product feels on my skin and it seems to be really hydrating for my fine lines. I do, however, wish the ingredients were a little more "clean". I will continue to use it and am happy to keep seeing results! It was complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth.

This eye cream is a lot of things, but I would say it's soothing over anything else. It feels really nice underneath my eyes and is super moisturizing. My eyes feel depuffed and smooth. When I use it during the day, I put on a really thin layer and let it absorb in and my makeup goes on over it without an issue. Complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth

ULTIMATE SOLUTION 5 EYE MULTITASKING is great eye cream. It has a creamy texture and gets absorbed into the skin really fast, My under eyes do look brighter and de-puff. Wrinkles and Fine lines look less visible! I have been using it in my morning routine. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

This eye cream was nice, nothing really special about it tho unfortunately. Thankfully didn't cause milia, but like I didn't really notice any difference, nor did I have a negative reaction. For what it is and the price, there's better options in my opinion *gifted but genuine review

This eye cream is rich and it spread nicely, easy to blend and absorbs easily.. It feels very nourishing on my dry skin (eye area), feels smooth and silky, hydrating and moisturizing.. I didn't notice and scent, it's not sticky, not greasy and it's not heavy.. Ive been using it for more than a week now and I like it though I haven't seen changes on my dark under-eyes but I understand that it needs time for it to work.. Gifted by Peterthomasroth

As someone with bags under their eyes big enough to carry groceries, I was very appreciative of this eye cream! I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare to try the Ultimate Solution 5 Eye Multitasking Eye Cream and my under eyes are rejoicing. This eye cream has been particularly helpful in reducing the look of my under eyes with makeup. Using the eye cream prior to applying my makeup was so helpful in reducing the look of my under eyes! I'm happy I finally found something that works for my under eyes. I recommend this eye cream to everyone with baggy under eyes like mine lol.

this cream is on the medium-thickness side which sometimes breaks me out. the smell is low which is important to me with my beauty products. i received this item complimentary from peterthomasroth but i dont think i would buy it.

After pregnancy, my under eyes look a lot darker and more drier. This product came out at the perfect time! I've been using this product for about two weeks now and noticed how hydrated my eyes look. I can't wait to see what the does for my dark circles offered by peterthomasroth

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth! All opinions are my own. I really enjoyed this product. I have only been using for about two weeks and I have noticed a slight change in my under eye circles! They look firmer and brighter! I think it would need a longer period of use just to be sure however in two weeks, I'm pretty pleased with results.

avis.titre: Nice but not worth the price
avis.texte: I was sent this eye cream complimentary from the brand in exchange for a review. I have been testing it for a couple of weeks and find it to be a simple eye cream that makes my under eyes feel hydrated and smooth. However I don't notice anything special about it and therefore, while it's a good product, I wouldn't recommend it for the price.

I received this product gifted by Peter Thomas Roth but the opinions are my own. I am a big eye cream enthusiast and was excited to try this one, since it is used for both AM/PM. It has certainly helped keep my undereye area more hydrated and supple. I've also noticed a softening of the lines directly under my eyes. I'm not sure if my dark circles have been noticeably improved yet, but I am also a 40-yo mom of four so it'll take a bit longer before I can weigh in. Great product that has been a perfect addition to my routine.

This eye cream is a little thicker, so I like to use it at night time before I go to bed. I've been using it for a few weeks & I do notice that it hydrates my under eyes very well. I have to use it longer to see more! *gifted by Peter Thomas Roth

This is thick and luxurious very very moisturizing! I have dry skin and have heavy under eye bags. I really do enjoy using this product but I would not recommend using it under makeup up its a little to slippery for me. I love it for night time! Gifted by peterthomasroth

This product was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth Clinical Skincare and I am absolutely loving it! I've been applying this every night to the area around my eyes and I've already been noticing a difference. It also is perfect to put under makeup and keep everything moisturized.

I was gifted by peterthomasroth in exchange for an honest review and i can say its been one of my favorite eye creams! Its hydrating and it has helped made my under eyes have that tighter look to them, ive always been a fan of this brand and this product is another hit!

This was gifted by Peter Roth Thomas Skincare and I must say, it worked really well and I saw the results right away after about 2 uses. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth Skincare. This multitasking eye cream is a great addition to my skincare routine. The moisture this delivers under my eyes lifts up my entire face with a little amount of product.

i started incorporating this product into my morning routine and it really helps with dark circles and the puffiness in the morning. it also is very hydrating and lightweight formula. gifted by brand !

The ultimate solutions 5 multitasking eye cream gifted by peterthomasRoth works great for my skin. I am noticing fewer fine lines and my skin tone is more even. My skin looks firmer and less under eye circles since I've started using

I received this complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. This eye cream feels very silky, and it made my undereye feel soooo smooth! I can't wait to see my results from a longer usage. I had no eye irritation or any issues.

I received the ULTIMATE SOLUTION 5 EYE MULTITASKING EYE CREAM complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth. I think it is a great product. It hydrates my skin and has definitely made a difference in my under-eye puffiness!

This eye cream should be in your skincare routine. You will not regret it!

Gifted by peter Thomas Roth! It's a very rich luxurious eye cream as I am using it from 10 days and i like it so far! I see my eye area look more bright and hydrated! It is surely helping with my dark circles! It helps with depuffing eyes too! Would love to continue using it and buy again!

I absolutely love this eye cream. It helps me to get rid of dark circles and look so much younger overall. Concealer application became a lot better too, as the skin is not dry anymore. I use it every night. It was gifted to me by peterthomasroth.

I received this gifted by Peter Thomas Roth product for review. This eye cream works so well in minimizing the look of dark circles and hydrating the delicate skin beneath my lids. It's so light and feels great underneath my lids.

Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth this eye cream was smoothing and helped keep wrinkles at bay! At first it does cause a bit of a tingling sensation but IT WAS NOT IRRITATING! Overall it's a great eye cream!

I really love this eye cream! I've been crazy about eye creams lately and they really show to help slow the aging and wrinkles around your eyes as you age. It's smooth and doesn't irritate my eyes at all ◡̈

Love the texture of this eye cream. My skin is very sensitive and I really love how it feels and how the skin looks after use. It blens super nice on the skin, also the scent is amazing. The skin looks hydratated. I receive complimentary from peterthomasroth

I received this product complimentary from Peter Thomas Roth in exchange for an honest review. I really like how this product feels on my skin. It's super nice and I feel like my under eyes are more moisturized in the morning.

I absolutely love this eye cream! I was gifted by Peter Thomas Roth, and I am a HUGE fan of Peter Thomas Roth, so I knew this would be good! Such an amazing eye cream that really does reduce the amount of fine lines and wrinkles that I've experienced on my face. My under eyes have never been so smooth and soft. Doesn't irritate or dry out my skin and has no smell. Gifted by Peter Thomas Roth.

avis.titre: Love this all in one product, lightweight and moisturizing
